remarks: Chic 2-Bed / 2-Bath Condo in Gated Palmer Hill - 77 Havemeyer Ln Unit 313.  Welcome to this stylish, turn-key 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo in the coveted gated Palmer Hill community - a perfectly located home in Stamford that blends comfort, convenience, and a touch of resort-style living. With about 1,100 sq ft of thoughtfully designed space, this unit delivers both everyday ease and elevated finishes.  Step inside to a bright, open-plan layout where the gourmet kitchen - complete with stainless steel appliances and marble or quartz countertops - flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas. The living room easily doubles as an entertaining hub or cozy retreat, and sliding out onto your private balcony takes "relax at home" to the next level.  The primary suite is coupled with a roomy walk-in closet and a full bathroom featuring double-vanity, whirlpool/shower setup, and direct access to the balcony. Access to all Palmer Hill amenities including pool, club house, exercise room, hot and under garage parking.
